facts.fact: The Sudanese Center for Policy Studies says Sudan is already a signatory to the African Union's Malabo Convention (undated in the source; article published 2026-07-19).
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The article says Sudan has yet to enact or implement the Convention: no privacy law, a 2018 draft data protection bill never enacted, and domestication still to do; the November 2025 decree authorities had issued no binding rules as of mid-2026.
